A term with at least two replaced columns has two linearly dependent columns (multiples of u), so it vanishes by the alternating property. Hence det(A+u v^T)=det(A)+Σ_{i=1}^n v_i det(A^{(i)}), where A^{(i)} is A with column i replaced by u. Now expand det(A^{(i)}) along column i.
